pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Anaconda-Navigator" to quit' && sleep 2 && { conda env list | grep -q 'data_analysis' && conda env remove -n data_analysis -y || true; } && conda create -n data_analysis -y && conda install -n data_analysis requests=2.31.0
instruction: Update all packages in the 'data_analysis' virtual environment to the latest versions via the Anaconda interface.
evaluator: [ $(conda list -n data_analysis --revisions | grep '(rev \d)' | wc -l) -gt 2 ] && echo True || echo False
